facts.fact: UNICEF's Tahoua office head said on 10 August 2026 that UNICEF had contributed to the computerisation ('informatisation') of 68% of communes nationwide for civil status; he gives no numerator or denominator, and states computerisation, not that the commune offices are connected.

systems.country_label: informatisation des communes / centres d'état civil
systems.owner: Ministère de l'Intérieur, with UNICEF support
systems.tiers: communes; 68% of communes nationwide computerised per UNICEF; in Tahoua region four communes (Tassara, Tillia, Takanamat, Tebaram) remain to be covered per the governor

note: The one fact is a share of communes computerised for civil registration, recorded as equipped; the document states no connection at any commune office.
